description: Search published French providers by text, place and category.

category.description: Category slug, from /categories. A parent slug also matches its children.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any case. A country the directory does not cover, as listed in /places, gives 400.

cursor.description: `page.nextCursor` from the previous response. Opaque. Send the same filters and `limit`.

q.description: Search text, with at least one letter or digit. Matches name, categories, attributes, description and place. Typos fall back to close matches.

sort.description: `relevance` needs `q` and is the default with it. `name` is the default without `q`. `recent` is newest first.

name: search_listings
